quotes.text: Party A: Beijing Baidu Netcom Science and Technology Co., Ltd.

This Agreement is dated April 29, 2010.

fields.value: Exclusive arrangement in favor of Party B and its affiliates: Party A grants Party B exclusive rights to construct, maintain and operate the Cooperation Channel, and Party B/affiliates are the exclusive cooperator and provider for Party A’s real estate and home furnishing channel; Party A may not enter identical or similar cooperation with Party B competitors for that channel’s real estate and home furnishing information, products and data.

quotes.text: Party A grants all-round exclusive rights to Party B to construct, maintain and operate the
Cooperation channel.
Party B and its affiliates will be the exclusive cooperator of Party A’s real estate and home furnishing
cooperation channel.
Party B and its affiliates will be the exclusive provider of real estate and home furnishing information, products and data in
Party A’s real estate and home furnishing channel.
Party A may not make any identical or similar cooperation regarding the real estate and home

ambiguities: Article VII extends exclusivity to “Party B and its affiliates,” but the affiliates are not identified by legal name.
The exclusivity lasts “During the term of this Agreement”; the term end is affected by the unstated actual channel upload date under clauses 3.1 and 3.3.
